items.name: context-selector
items.title: DHIS2 Context Selector
items.description: Composable, controlled Capture-style context selector primitives for React 18 DHIS2 applications.

items.name: relationship-viewer
items.title: DHIS2 Relationship Viewer
items.description: A composable React 18 Relationship Viewer block that draws the relationship graph around DHIS2 tracker records.
items.docs: Render RelationshipViewer beneath the DHIS2 app-runtime and TanStack Query providers. The minimal composition is RelationshipViewer with RelationshipViewerCanvas, RelationshipViewerLegend, RelationshipViewerSummary, RelationshipViewerNotices and RelationshipViewerList as children.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Navigation with expandable groups, footer actions and a collapsible sidebar.
items.docs: Use SidebarLink with render={<NavLink to="/projects" />} to highlight the current page. Add SidebarGroup for nested links and SidebarButton for footer actions. Use SidebarToggle in the sidebar or useSidebar() for a page-toolbar control. Give each sidebar its own SidebarProvider and SidebarNavigation. Collapsing preserves expanded groups and the selected page.

items.name: working-list
items.title: DHIS2 Working List
items.description: A composable React 18 Working List block for DHIS2 tracker programs.
items.docs: Render WorkingList beneath the DHIS2 app-runtime and TanStack Query providers. Compose WorkingListViewSwitcher, WorkingListToolbar with its column/filter/action controls, and WorkingListTable. View selection and pagination work uncontrolled by default or as independent controlled value/callback pairs.
